notes.title: Get Ready for Life Gallery at Steam's Lunar New Year Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers! Life Gallery is about to participate in Steam's Lunar New Year Sale with all-time low discounts to players around the world! come join this audio-visual feast and get a great value gaming experience.

Event Period: From 10:00, Jan. 26, 2025 to 10:00, Feb. 9, 2025 (PT)
Discount: 55% off

Life Gallery is a puzzle game with a unique, illustration-style art design that leads the players into a world of deep mind horror.
